dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Overview of this orchestrator and the nodes it manages.
dashboard.setupIntro: Complete these steps to make the orchestrator production ready.
dashboard.stepMail: Configure the mail server for alerts

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.intro: Machines enrolled with this orchestrator. Approve new nodes, assign their role and keep an eye on them.
nodes.pendingIntro: Check that the fingerprint matches the one shown on the node before you approve it.
nodes.none: No nodes yet. Use Add node to install the client on a machine.
nodes.name: Name
nodes.rebootConfirm: Reboot {{name}}? If it is on air, the broadcast from this node stops until it is back.
nodes.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? The node has to be enrolled again to come back.
nodes.queued: Command sent. The node picks it up within a few seconds.
nodes.installIntro: Install the client on the machine, then approve it here.
nodes.afterInstall: The node then appears under Waiting for approval with a fingerprint. The same fingerprint is shown on the node (tvsm-agent status).
nodes.studio: Windows studio node (CasparCG + DeckLink + RTMP ingest)
nodes.studioHint: Run in PowerShell as Administrator. Installs the agent, CasparCG Server and the RTMP ingest server, and writes the CasparCG configuration. Fill in the media share and the management node address.

atem.title: ATEM switchers
atem.intro: Every Blackmagic ATEM in the facility, with model, inputs and live tally. The orchestrator only watches: switching is done by the management node.
atem.name: Name
atem.hostHint: The orchestrator connects over the ATEM protocol (UDP 9910), just like ATEM Software Control.
atem.emptyHint: Add an ATEM by its IP address. Model, inputs and names are read from the device.
atem.neverSeen: The orchestrator has not reached this switcher yet. Check the IP address and that UDP port 9910 is open.
atem.offlineSnapshot: The switcher is offline. You are looking at the last known state.
atem.frontPanelHint: Click a source button to rename that input. The labels are written to the ATEM itself.
atem.frontPanelReadOnly: Live view of the switcher's source buttons and tally.
atem.noControl: View only: the orchestrator never switches sources.
atem.inputsIntro: Names are read from and written to the switcher. "Fed by" records which node is connected to the input.
atem.namesHint: The long name appears in the multiview and ATEM Software Control, the short name on button labels of hardware panels. Letters, digits and basic punctuation only.
atem.fedByHint: Only stored in the orchestrator, for the equipment overview.
atem.offlineRename: The switcher is offline: names can only be changed while it is connected. You can still change the link and note.
atem.removeText: {{name}} is removed from the orchestrator. Nothing changes on the switcher itself.
atem.err_host_exists: A switcher with this address is already registered.
atem.err_atem_offline: The switcher is offline; try again when it is connected.
atem.err_unknown_input: This input does not exist on the switcher.
atem.err_forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
atem.err_validation_failed: Check the fields: names may only contain plain characters (long max 20, short max 4).
